# FG-REPO-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 410 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `pending_deletion_blocks_everything_but_restore` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このプロジェクトは削除予定のため操作できません。
- en: This project is scheduled for deletion and cannot be used.
- id: Proyek ini dijadwalkan untuk dihapus dan tidak dapat digunakan.

## 原因 (cause)

The project was deleted and is inside its grace period; only restore (or the purge job) may act on it.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `action`. The audit log has the `project.deleted` entry with who deleted it and when.

## 対処 (fix)

An Owner (or an administrator) restores the project before the grace period ends, if the deletion was a mistake.
